task_nature_route.py.how_it_entered: It did not newly go silent. Until ebe08a870 its CLI died on UnboundLocalError for every invocation without --json -- a defect present since the file's first commit -- so the survey classified it NOT_DRIVABLE and it never entered the denominator. Repairing the crash moved it into `driven`, where a silence that had always been there became visible and took the old count bound from 27 to 28. MEASURED, one file, both directions: at ebe08a870^ NOT_DRIVABLE, at HEAD SILENT, with nothing about its reporting changed. That is a ratchet punishing a repair, and it is why this register is a SET and not a number.

the_bound: sweep_reach_survey --silent-set refuses on any SILENT sweep named in NEITHER list below.
